findings.finding: Adult Walter faces the opponent with both pistols visible and separate, coat, trouser legs, hair and both shoes complete. No opaque source background or material alpha halo visible at gameplay scale. Lowest shoe pixels extend 2.47 px below the floor anchor; stable and acceptable in both slots.

Downpour Bogeyman faces the opponent in both slots. Entire hammer head and shaft, hands, mask, coat and both shoes remain visible; no cut exterior or alpha rectangle/halo apparent. Lowest shoe pixels extend 1.08 px below the floor anchor; stable and acceptable.
